author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The Aoostar AG03 is one of the best eGPUs around: built-in 800W power supply, lots of connectivity (TB5, USB4, and OCuLink), and about half the price of competing ThunderBolt 5 eGPU docks. Let's test it out across a variety of use cases.

More info: https://aoostar.com/products/aoostar-ag03-egpu-dock/?ref=RGC
on Amazon: https://amzn.to/3OYEMVZ
